agents.name: SENJU
agents.mandate: Apply the Senju self-improvement loop to the Vercel app. Focus on reliability, correctness, test coverage, and bounded improvements backed by evidence. Never weaken safety gates.

agents.name: X
agents.mandate: Identify and implement high-value experimental features and external integrations for the AI Foundry IDE. Focus on new capabilities: multi-model support (Claude, Gemini), GitHub repo read/write, live eval dashboards, and rapid prototyping paths.

agents.name: META
agents.mandate: Improve the meta-level architecture of the AI Foundry IDE. Focus on system coherence, cross-agent coordination, deployment pipeline, observability, and making the app itself more self-improving. Think at the system level.

tournament_rule: Each agent proposes one bounded improvement per cycle. The highest-priority valid proposal (passing local lint and smoke test) is promoted. Ties broken by priority_weight.
